
## Complexity Analysis
- **Time Complexity:** `O(1)`

## Implementation
```c
int detect_array_missing_number(const int* arr, int n) {
    int total_xor = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) total_xor ^= i;

}
```

```c
static int ccw_check(float ax, float ay, float bx, float by, float cx, float cy) {
```
